dimensions.evidenceA: Fathers, children, grandchildren, and later generations are named.
dimensions.evidenceB: Father and son are separated by their own conduct.
dimensions.label: Family relation

dimensions.evidenceB: The verbs are bearing, living, and dying.
dimensions.label: Judgment wording

evidence.observation: The LORD says he visits the fathers’ iniquity on children and later generations.
The LORD says a son does not bear his father’s iniquity and the soul who sins dies.

record.tension: One source speaks of ancestral iniquity being visited across generations, while another says the son does not bear the father’s iniquity.
record.title: Whose iniquity or sin reaches a later generation?
